notes.title: New, updated demo of Greek Tragedy is available now!
notes.content:
[h3]Ready to uncover secrets in your midwestern home of... Horror?[/h3]

It's true that it's been a while since we contacted you but here we are with something you may be interested in! [b]Greek Tragedy just got a new, updated version of demo, here on Steam![/b] 🏛️

This means two things. First, from now on you can immerse yourself in this sneak peak of our retro-styled, 90's era indie survival horror game in a new way, and find out for yourself, what started to happen at Southern Michigan University. 📺

Second... 

[b]Well, we can't reveal it to you yet, but follow us and stay tuned, that's all we can say 🔪[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/939240209b63b6edea070387b5aab67a88f1f341.jpg[/img]

Here's the list of changes in the new version ⤵️

➡️ Redesigned lightning and post processing effects in multiple areas 
➡️ Adjusted lighting effect in student dormroom
➡️ Working on controller support (ending A is now possible to complete with controller-only)
➡️ Fixed intro logos and video on various monitor aspect ratios
➡️ Tweaked tint of Poseidon material and spotlight in Student Union for improved visibility
➡️ English language version reworked (redoing sensitive dialogues)
➡️ Added support for a specific mode death screen
➡️ Minor GFX fixes


[b]It's time to face reality and expose the truth behind it. Get ready for it.

Until nex time...[/b]

notes.title: Looking back at 2023 & status update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Students![/b]

We have been busy working on Greek Tragedy. The past few months were extremely intense for our small, but very dedicated team. 

We spent days and nights on improving Greek Tragedy, preparing for its official release. We mainly focused on [b]performance[/b] so that players who use lower-end computers would have a great and smooth experience. Making sure the game is well balanced requires a lot… seriously, A LOT of small & big tweaks, adjustments, tests and time - hence the silence.

We took a closer look at [b]lighting[/b] in some of the scenes and discovered a need to rebuild every light, using a different technology than out of the box lighting. This change [b]greatly increased performance[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/d6fc81de5ff8102ffd76c07467e36a10a4963c59.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/c30770bd551e4ce5e8c89b72bbc804accd0fce90.png[/img]

It feels like we spent tons of hours on finding the perfect solution. In the meantime we also found some light-related bugs that we were able to address. 

________________________________________________________

Performance and game fixes weren’t the only things we focused on.
To spread the word about Greek Tragedy, we took part in many local events this past year.

We started 2023 off by visiting [b]Ohayocon[/b] in January. 
Ohayocon is a three-day long anime convention typically held in Columbus, Ohio. As we’re from Michigan, it was a lot of fun to be a part of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/efc34fdb3c9a09b4daca2085d87d08091b8f78a0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/2599842f786577ea9691956803f761b99ff630d3.jpg[/img]

The second event that we visited in 2023 was [b]The Game Designer Expo[/b]. 
This one took place in our hometown - Ann Arbor, Michigan! Michigan is home to numerous game developers. game designers etc. The Game Designer Expo is a great way to celebrate gaming and a huge chance for people to sample their diverse and creative work, so we felt like it was a must for us to be there and showcase our game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/b606d58e9fa98568ac3bc50ce15d2b0a3b5a53cb.jpg[/img]

Our 3rd event - [b]GDEX[/b] took place in June 2023 so we made it to Columbus, OH again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/7fdadd6a24dab739b0681ed1f731eedaf430e3dd.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/ac71e30aae2862240722a540b5e3e2280e37ab28.jpg[/img]

A few months after that we visited Detroit for [b]Youmacon[/b] which made it the last event of 2023 for us! It was a lot of fun to be there with our Greek Tragedy and to see everybody get through the demo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/98cd1389b921a2de4b3c5ab002861da9cda63cb2.jpg[/img]


[b]Wishlist and follow Greek Tragedy[/b] as it helps spread the word and make the game more visible on Steam + will keep you tuned to our news! Expect more frequent updates from us as we're preparing for our release date announcement!

We also have a Discord server in which you can talk to us,
We'd love to hear your feedback & experiences after playing our demo!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/w4djKqm8Q8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/361a10df6832e53e63abd87fe010d61bc95a95ba.png[/img][/url]


Till next time!
Cute Spooks, Prairieville Games & Pineapple Works

notes.title: We have updated our demo!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Students,[/h3]

We have been gathering your feedback regarding the initial version of our demo for quite some time now. We have gone through it very carefully, decided to make a few improvements and fix any bugs that were reported to us either by you or our QA team. 

Some of you have played our demo that's available here, others had a chance to try it out at events such as YumaCon, OHAYOCON or GDEX! The events were a great experience and we're extremely happy we got to meet everyone, chat with you and watch you play. 
Especially during the events we have noticed that some players found it more challenging and difficult to get through the first few minutes of gameplay in which they were introduced to tank controls, very narrow paths and first puzzle.

To make it more accessible and easier to get used to, we decided to add a few additional minutes of gameplay that will hopefully be a good introduction to what you can expect later in game... 
What else changed?

[h3][b]Here's our full change log:[/b][/h3]
[list] [*] A few minutes of additional content that provides much improved pacing and more gradual puzzle difficulty[/list][list] [*] Bug fixes [/list][list] [*] Randomized puzzle solutions [/list][list]
[*] Performance optimization for lower-end devices. [/list]

We will leave it for you to find out where those additional few minutes were added and what they bring. At the same time we would love to hear your feedback regarding the changes!  

Here's a small teaser:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/2ccc788b48ae15aff35c37a2194f7131ab0598ab.gif[/img]


[b]Thank you for your continuous support, we couldn't ask for better students![/b]



Join our Discord 🔻
[url=https://discord.gg/mP8YHVw5wp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42473300/32ac917c0b197fb7602e36e0bba21069604e9b41.png[/img][/url]
